preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of roads must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of days k needed to repair all roads.
The output must contain k + 1 lines, with the first line being the number of days.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == d + 1 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each of the next k lines must start with the number of roads to be repaired and follow with the road numbers.
